props.title: The evolving interface between humans and agents.
props.lead: Your agent's answers become interfaces — interactive, archived, and evolving as you use them.

content.text: Your agent answers with an interface, and the interface has three properties:

cards.title: Interactive
cards.body: Agents answer with charts, calculators and diagrams you can adjust, compare and explore.

cards.title: Archived
cards.body: Every interface is saved as your own page with full history; the agent continues from your edits, and you can export it for others.

cards.title: Evolving
cards.body: When an expression is missing, the agent builds a new component; pages that work become templates, so each round starts from a better place.

content.text: ShowAI works inside the agent you already use: the plugin lets your agent build interfaces, and the ShowAI app keeps, opens and edits them.
You need a Mac with Apple silicon (macOS 13 or later), and Claude Code or Codex signed in. No agent yet? Use the built-in agent with a model API key.

steps.title: Download ShowAI
steps.body: Open the DMG and drag ShowAI into Applications. Download the [latest release](https://github.com/Renaissance-Mind/ShowAI/releases/latest).

steps.title: Connect your agent
steps.body: Open ShowAI; the welcome screen finds Claude Code or Codex. Click Install plugin, then restart the agent.

steps.title: Ask for an interface
steps.body:
Paste the sample prompt into a new conversation:
“Use ShowAI to build a mortgage calculator: price, down payment, rate and term are adjustable; show the monthly payment and total interest.”

The diagram below shows where an interface goes, from your question to sharing it. Select any part to see its description and the related docs.

nodes.label: You
nodes.detail: Describe the interface you want in your agent; use it as soon as you get it, or edit its text, charts and component settings in the app.

nodes.label: ShowAI App
nodes.detail: Keeps, opens and edits interfaces. A Page arranges content in order, a Board places it freely, and each can be nested in the other.

nodes.label: Agent
nodes.detail: Claude Code and Codex install the plugin in one click from Settings → Plugins in the app; the app also has a built-in agent. For the status of other agents, see “Use with an Agent”.

nodes.label: ShowAI plugin
nodes.detail: The plugin gives the agent ShowAI's tools and skills. The agent reads the complete page first and saves with its version number, so it **never silently overwrites** the edits you just made.

nodes.label: Content Library
nodes.detail: Projects, pages, components and templates are stored in the local content library with full version history. In a conflict, both versions are kept for you to compare and merge.

nodes.label: Server / Cloud
nodes.detail: When collaboration across devices or multiple people is required, connect to the self-deployed ShowAI Server or ShowAI Cloud. Edit as usual when offline, and synchronize after connecting to the Internet.

nodes.label: Export
nodes.detail: A single HTML file carries the reader, data and components, so it stays interactive offline without ShowAI; a static site organizes a project's pages into a site with navigation.

props.caption: The solid line is reading and writing within the local machine; the dashed line is optional cross-device synchronization.

attrs.title: Do I need to register an account or connect to the Internet to use ShowAI?

content.text: No. The app runs on your computer and keeps content in a local content library. The agent itself signs in and goes online in its own way; to sync across devices or work with others, connect a

Claude Code, Codex and the built-in agent are supported; Claude Code and Codex install the plugin in one click from Settings → Plugins in the app. DeepSeek Harness and Kimi are in preview, ChatGPT on the web is invite only, and other MCP clients can be configured manually (experimental). See
The released app supports only Macs with Apple silicon. On Windows and Linux, run the local browser edition from source; see

attrs.title: Do the app and the agent see the same projects?

content.text: Yes, as long as they point to the same content library. A plugin installed from the app uses the app's current library; after switching libraries or moving the app, click Update and enable in Settings → Plugins. Choose the library in Settings → General → Content library.

attrs.title: The page I am changing is also being changed by the Agent. Will they cover each other?

content.text: No. The later save is paused and both versions are kept for comparison; you can choose “Compare and merge” or “Keep as copy”. See

attrs.title: If you send the exported HTML to others, what do they need to install?

content.text: Nothing. The single HTML file carries the reader, data and components and opens in any browser; charts, collapsible sections and local calculations work offline. External links still need a network, and images must be embedded in the page. See

attrs.title: Can the interface be switched to English?

content.text: Can. The workbench supports Simplified Chinese and English. By default, it "follows the system" and can be switched in "Settings → Appearance → Language". The reader control of the exported page uses the language in which it was exported.
